title: Country manifest: the documents analysed for one country
description: Edited by people. Country is the top-level container: stage 1 runs once per document listed here, stage 2 runs once per country over all of them. Every extraction's document_id must appear in this list.

document_id.description: <country>-<kind><edition>, unique across all countries; it prefixes every record ID

edition_date.description: ISO date; orders editions and decides the 'latest document' stage

file.description: PDF path relative to the country folder

supersedes.description: document_id of the earlier edition this one replaces, if any

pages_in_scope.description: 'all' or a page range such as '1-40'; what stage 1 was asked to read
